description: This Scala source file defines the FlowPlanner class, which plans execution of data flows in a Spark data pipeline by converting Flow objects into executable FlowExecution objects, handling both batch and streaming flows.

classes.name: FlowPlanner
classes.description: A class that plans execution of Flow objects in a DataflowGraph, converting them into FlowExecution instances for batch or streaming processing.

methods.name: plan
methods.description: Converts a ResolvedFlow into a FlowExecution, handling different flow types (CompleteFlow, StreamingFlow) and their respective destinations.
